content_blocks.label: clause_1._REASON_FOR_NOTICE
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you are in default of the lease agreement due to non-payment of rent as required.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._TIME_TO_COMPLY
content_blocks.text: You have thirty (30) days from the date of this notice to remedy the default and continue to occupy the premises.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._ACTION_IF_DEFAULT_CONTINUES
content_blocks.text: If the default is not remedied within the thirty (30) day period, the landlord reserves the right to commence an action for eviction.
